from pathlib import Path

P=load_story_package(Path("data/stories/continuity-initiative"))
class R:
    def __init__(s,b): s.b=json.dumps(b).encode()
    def __enter__(s): return s
    def __exit__(s,*a): pass
    def read(s): return s.b
calls=[]
def fake(req,**k):
    calls.append(json.loads(req.data)["user"][:0])
    return R({"narration":json.dumps({"segments":[{"kind":"narration","text":"Kristin looks at the gap."}],"selected_knowledge_ids":[]})})

st.active_event_ids.update({"SL-1A-E","SL-1A-F"})

    eng=RuntimeEngine(st,prov)
    for cmd in ["Open the drawer.","Search the gap."]:
        r=eng.turn(cmd)
        print(cmd,"->",r.selected_knowledge_ids,prov.last_reveal_selection.get("outcome"), "|", r.narration[:140])
    print("card:",any(f.predicate=="memory_card_recovered" for f in st.facts.asserted), "delivered_cues:",st.delivered_cue_ids)
